source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
title: Injured — under treatment & discharged in Kathmandu (NDRRMA / DEOC)
citation: NDRRMA X + District Emergency Operation Centre Kathmandu — notice 392
body: NDRRMA (31 Aug) linked the updated list of people rescued from the Rasuwa flood and brought to Kathmandu for treatment — currently under treatment and discharged. Source: District Emergency Operation Centre, Kathmandu. Open the official NDRRMA notice. This site links only; we do not copy names.
